name: adaptive_aero_control_top
description: Top-level synthesis target. Implements request ingress, packet capture, validation, stale/timeout tracking, response handling, clamp generation, safe fallback override, CSR control/status access, and registered actuator outputs. This module is the required design top and shall not be substituted.
functionality: Implements the complete control-plane contract for an adaptive aero controller. The module accepts 64-bit request packets on req_valid/req_ready, captures packet metadata on accepted handshakes, validates request format and operating envelope, tracks request sequence monotonicity and age against a programmable timeout, emits model-request traffic according to the external transport contract with model-request valid/data driven as outputs and model-request ready received as an input, receives model-response valid/data as inputs and emits model-response ready as an output, latches compact response metadata, synthesizes a bounded actuator recommendation summary, clamps the command to CSR-programmed limits, and forces a deterministic safe actuator state when response data is invalid, stale, timed out, malformed, or otherwise rejected. CSR accesses configure timeout threshold, clamp limits, operating mode, safe-state selection, fault clearing, and status readback. The module keeps sticky fault flags until cleared by CSR and registers every externally visible output.
behavior_rules: The hierarchy top_module entry is the only legal top-level implementation target.
